title: Ariel Shamai Engaged
body: Ariel Shamai, a prominent "Torah prisoner," is engaged. The talmid of Yeshivas Ateres Shlomo was known for refusing to enlist in the army. His fiancée is from the Adler family.

title: Yosef Slams Draft Arrests
body: Rav Yitzchok Yosef spoke out against the draft crisis, stating that almost all yeshiva students arrested by the army are Sephardi bochurim, delivering an emotional address at a Motzoei Shabbos gathering.

title: Satmar Rebbe's Gold Cane
body: Satmar Rebbe Rav Aharon Teitelbaim received a custom gold cane at his great-granddaughter's wedding in the US, marking a milestone in marrying off a fourth-generation descendant.
